rules.quote: § 2.1 Fees must be charged at the hourly rates agreed for each fee earner on the matter.
§ 2.2 We will not pay for time spent by trainees and summer associates.
§ 2.4 Attendance at a deposition is limited to one fee earner; time of additional attendees will not be paid.
§ 2.5 Attendance at a hearing or court appearance is limited to two fee earners; time of additional attendees will not be paid.
§ 3.1 All time must be recorded in units of six minutes (0.1 hour); we do not accept minimum charges for letters, emails or calls.
§ 3.2 Block billing is not acceptable, and entries combining several tasks will not be paid.
Generic descriptions (for example "review documents" or "work on matter") will not be paid.
§ 3.4 We will not pay for more than 12 hours charged by one fee earner on any one day.
§ 4.1 Secretarial and administrative tasks, such as photocopying, filing, diary management, scheduling and arranging couriers, are part of your overheads and must not be charged.
§ 4.2 Internal meetings and discussions between fee earners of your firm will not be paid.
§ 4.3 Research of more than 5 hours on a matter in a month must be approved in advance; unapproved research above 5 hours will not be paid.
§ 5.1 Travel time will not be paid.
§ 6.1 We will not reimburse word processing, facsimile, telephone and meals.
§ 6.2 Copying charges must not exceed £0.15 per page.
§ 7.2 Invoices received more than 90 days after the end of the month in which the work was done will not be paid.
§ 7.3 Fees in excess of the agreed budget will not be paid unless we approved the increase before the work was done.
